proof:
by
  simp only [Category.split_mono, Category.IsSection]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ c k
    refine ⟨k ≫ g, ?_⟩
    first
      | simp [hg]
      | simp [hg, Category.assoc, Category.comp_id]
      | (rw [Category.assoc, hg, Category.comp_id])
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h Y (id Y)
    exact ⟨g, hg⟩
